contexts.text: Jacob took him a fresh rod of poplar () = the proper power of natural good... Poplar = the good of the Natural.
Some species of trees = exterior goods and truths, which are of the natural man; as the poplar...

The poplar which is here named is the white poplar, so called from its whiteness, from which is the derivation. Hence it was that by the poplar was signified the good which is from truth; or, what is the same, the good of truth; as in ; but there falsified.
The leaves of the poplar, etc., = rational truths from sensuous light.
The floor of the house was of boards of poplar.
